Floor details & rewards

Number format: 1.234.567,89 (dot = thousands; comma = decimals). Level-scaled stats use the stored StandardLevel as the exponent: HP = base × growth^(2 × StandardLevel); ATK/DEF = base × growth^StandardLevel. Displayed monster level = StandardLevel + 1 (experimentally checked on selected floors above 1000). ATK/DEF exclude equipment and non-elite buffs. Elite HP uses an estimated shared rule: bonus = ceil(10 × (HpScaleBase + HpScaleAdd × option level)) / 10; multiplier = 1 + bonus. At option level 1: projectile immune, melee immune and mortar ×2.8; stat up ×4.2. Projectile immune and stat up HP at option level 1 are experimentally supported; other cases are estimates pending verification. Unknown options are excluded. ATK elite bonuses use the unverified HP-style rounding hypothesis: at option level 1, projectile/melee immune ×1.4 and stat up ×1.6. Their explicit DEF bonus parameters are zero (×1). Mortar ATK/DEF parameters are assumed from immunity elites (level 1: ATK ×1.4, DEF ×1), not provided by the JSON; this extrapolation is unverified. Calculations use float32 precision; exact combat rounding may differ. “Stage option” means explicitly assigned on this floor; available elite options are not automatically active.
